title: Merch Ads Demand Feed
description: Contract between the Amazon Ads automation tool and MerchPirate. Written every ~2 days to Ads/outputs/demand_feed.json. keyword_seeds = proven-converting customer searches (make NEW designs); proven_sellers = top-earning ASINs (make VARIATIONS).

generated.description: Snapshot date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the source data.

keyword_seeds.description: New-design ideas. Make designs targeting these phrases. Order by `orders` desc for priority.

term.description: Customer search phrase = design intent. Feed to MerchPirate prompt generation.

niche.description: Source ad campaign name (context only; free text, e.g. 'Lotto 2').

product_type.description: Merch export product type. See known values in demand_feed.context.md. Unknown -> treat as standard_tshirt.

proven_sellers.description: Top-earning live ASINs. Route to MerchPirate prompt-recovery to make variations.
